mapper.select:
select edu_course_package_exam.has_publish_score,edu_course_package_exam.id as middleId,edu_course_package_exam.custom_exampaper_name as middleName,edu_course_package_exam.clazz_id as middleClazz ,exam_exampaper.*,edu_course.course_name as clazz_name
, (select count(1) from exam_exampaper_record where exam_exampaper_record.middle_id=edu_course_package_exam.id and exam_exampaper_record.user_id in
#{item} ) as exam_num
, (select count(1) from exam_exampaper_record where exam_exampaper_record.middle_id=edu_course_package_exam.id and exam_exampaper_record.clazz_id=#{coursePackageExam.clazzId}) as exam_num , (select count(1) from exam_exampaper_record where exam_exampaper_record.middle_id=edu_course_package_exam.id and exam_exampaper_record.clazz_id=#{coursePackageExam.clazzId} and pigai_status=1) as pigai_num
, (select avg(user_score) from exam_exampaper_record where exam_exampaper_record.middle_id=edu_course_package_exam.id and exam_exampaper_record.clazz_id=#{coursePackageExam.clazzId} and pigai_status=1) as avg
, (select sum(qst_score) from exam_exampaper_record where exam_exampaper_record.middle_id=edu_course_package_exam.id and exam_exampaper_record.clazz_id=#{coursePackageExam.clazzId} and pigai_status=1) as sum_score
from edu_course_package_exam left join exam_exampaper on edu_course_package_exam.exampaper_id = exam_exampaper.id left join edu_course on edu_course_package_exam.clazz_id = edu_course.id
1=1
and edu_course_package_exam.clazz_id = #{coursePackageExam.clazzId}
and exam_exampaper.name like concat('%',#{coursePackageExam.examName},'%')
and exam_exampaper.type=#{coursePackageExam.examType}
and edu_course_package_exam.clazz_id in
#{item}
order by edu_course_package_exam.sort desc
